evidence: Changes P2P transaction download and orphan tracking in `src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp`, `src/node/txorphanage.cpp`, `src/txrequest.cpp`, and `src/net_processing.cpp`.
rationale: Plugs multiple liveness and stalling vulnerabilities where adversarial peers can permanently prevent honest 1p1c CPFP transactions from reaching the mempool. Peers can intentionally pin orphans by disconnecting during assigned reconsideration, poison wtxid-keyed reject filters with witness-stripped transactions, and wipe orphan state across all peers on reconsiderable feerate failures.
